text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I can feel the wind even more keenly today. I don't think I'll have any trouble concentrating.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Good. As I train, I'll surrender myself to the wind's embrace.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my, an unusual wind… Is there something over there?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Wow! I had no idea such a place was hidden away here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And the wind feels wonderful too… It's very soothing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I wish I could stay here in the wind forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr loses herself in the wind and ends up forgetting to attend her training session.
